depends_on: Gauss congruence for traces of integer matrices: tr(A^{9t}) = tr(A^{3t}) mod 9
Singer difference sets in PG(2,q) / finite-field generation lemmas
notes: Both true. Period mod 9 = order of companion matrix M of f = x^n - x^{n-1} - ... - 1. If M^Q = I mod 9 with 3 not dividing Q, Gauss congruence gives s_3 = s_1 mod 9, but s_1 = 1, s_3 = 7 (n>=3) or 4: so 3 | a(n), and a = 3P when 3 does not divide the mod-3 period P. (x-1)f = x^{n+1}+x^n+1 mod 3; n = 3^m-1: roots 1/(1+c g0) in F_{q^2} generate F_{q^2}^*, P = q^2-1; n = 3^m: Hilbert 90 maps ker Tr (a line of PG(2,q)) onto the roots, Singer difference set gives P = q^2+q+1. Hence Helenius's formulas. Outside Lean: everything; checked a(n) = 3*ord3(n) for n <= 100 (b-file) and ord3 closed forms for m <= 6 (PARI). Mathlib lacks Gauss trace congruence mod p^2; formalization estimated at several hours (closed-walk orbit counting, companion-matrix traces, finite-field generation).
